results.title: Bigg Boss Malayalam 8: Firoz Khan calls Noby ‘the biggest poison’ in the house, says ‘One should not ruin someone’s life for content’
results.description: Firoz also shared his thoughts on the female contestant, expressing admiration for the way she conducted herself inside the Bigg Boss house. “That girl behaved so beautifully in the house. One should never go to the extent of ruining someone’s life just for the sake of content,” he said.
